Another Milestone for Rudolph Logistics North America

We are excited to announce that Rudolph Logistics has been selected by Polarium as its warehouse and logistics partner in the US.

This opportunity shows the trust our customers place in our team, our operational experience, and our commitment to delivering successful supply chain solutions with speed, quality, and reliability.

Today, we are proud to say that we are approaching full capacity across both of our warehouses, a testament to the confidence our customers continue to place in Rudolph Logistics.

# Today, we're proud to unveil the expansion of RPM Group's Summerville, South Carolina operation. · 2026-07-23T00:00:00+00:00

Today, we're proud to unveil the expansion of RPM Group's Summerville, South Carolina operation.

With the addition of 100,000 square feet, we've increased warehouse capacity by nearly 30% while adding integrated bulk receiving capabilities—further strengthening our Port-to-Plant supply chain and reinforcing Summerville as one of the premier green coffee logistics hubs in the United States.

This milestone wouldn't have been possible without our incredible RPM team who brought this vision to life. We also appreciate and recognize the collaboration of so many outstanding partners. Thank you to our local Berkeley County (SC) Government and state leaders, the South Carolina Ports team, our construction Choate Construction Company and development partners, and our talented film Motion Filmworks production crew.

To our valued customers and strategic partners—thank you for your continued trust. Your growth drives our investment, and we're excited for what's ahead.

Progress is here. The future is now.

#RPMGroup #PortToPlant #GreenCoffee #SupplyChain #Logistics

# G10 Fulfillment to Celebrate Grand Opening of New Kenosha Distribution Facility with Ribbon-Cutting Ceremony 

 Cision PR Newswire Send an email (david.argueta@cision.com) 1 September 2026

Mayor and Kenosha County Executive to join company and community leaders in marking the milestone expansion

KENOSHA, Wis., Sept. 1, 2026 /PRNewswire/ — G10 Fulfillment, a North American third-party logistics and fulfillment provider, will hold a ribbon-cutting ceremony celebrating the grand opening of its new distribution facility in Kenosha, Wisconsin, on Thursday, September 10, 2026, at 11:00 a.m. at 12345 38th Street.

The new 315,000-square-foot facility replaces G10’s former Twin Lakes location and more than doubles the company’s Midwest warehouse capacity. Positioned along the Chicago–Milwaukee freight corridor, the site supports large-scale order fulfillment and regional inventory distribution as part of G10’s broader logistics network.

# NXHD/US group company completes new warehouse for the automotive industry in Ohio 

August 15, 2026 / Logistics facilities

NX Automotive Logistics America (NXAL), a subsidiary of NIPPON EXPRESS Holdings (HD), held a completion ceremony for its fourth warehouse on April 15th at its headquarters site in East Liberty, Ohio, USA.

 

Warehouse No. 4 has a total floor area of ​​16,762 m2.

With storage, export packaging, and warehouse operations capabilities, the facility will meet the growing demand for automotive-related logistics in the US Midwest, and leverage its proximity to production sites to strengthen its ability to provide customers with fast and stable logistics services.

Since its establishment in September 1989, NXAL has been based in Ohio, USA, providing logistics services primarily to the automotive industry, including production logistics support, warehousing and inventory management, kitting, export packaging, and packaging conversion.
